mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_prompt (gateway_id, name, description, arguments_json, template, status) VALUES (#{gatewayId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{argumentsJson}, #{template}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_prompt SET description = #{description}, arguments_json = #{argumentsJson}, template = #{template}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_prompt WHERE gateway_id = #{gatewayId} AND name = #{name}
SELECT * FROM mcp_prompt WHERE gateway_id = #{gatewayId} ORDER BY id
